files.index.html:
Install and update apps from the catalog, right here in the browser — no agent needed. Updates never run on their own. For a custom app that is not in the catalog, ask an agent to add it with MCP add_app. Removing an app is agent-only, through MCP remove_app. Pin, hide, and home are managed from Apps Edit.

This App Store needs JavaScript to load the catalog. Without JavaScript, ask an agent to install apps with add_app.
